t: This is the Burma Railway Memorial, beside Camden High Street near Mornington Crescent tube station. It remembers the thousands of British civilian and military prisoners of war in the Far East who died of disease, starvation or maltreatment while building the Burma Railway during the Second World War. It was designed by the architect Chris Roche. Take a moment here. Many people pass this spot every day, and it asks you to remember the men and women who suffered and died far from home.
